name: Framework LED Matrix Helper
author: Steve Godlewski
description: Control center for Framework 16 LED Matrix panels: preview patterns, text, animations, and effects on a live emulation of both panels before applying them, draw your own patterns in a pixel-art editor with a shareable PNG library, and manage per-panel power and firmware updates

barWidget.description: Preview and drive the LED Matrix panels: patterns, text, animations, pixel-art editor, firmware
